title: Import data
description: Upload a CSV or Excel file, map columns, preview row issues, then confirm. Creates go through the same rules as the normal forms. Invalid rows are never written; you can skip any row.
notAllowed: You do not have permission to import any of the supported record types.
templateHint: CSV template with example row. Excel (.xlsx) uploads are also accepted.
expensesSafeHint: Expense import creates drafts only through the normal expense rules. Tax/VAT columns are ignored. Currency must match the project or organization base currency.
nonFinancialHint: Project/job import does not set contract amounts. Use Opening values for managed openings. Duplicate names are flagged as warnings.
openingValuesHint: Opening values use the same contract opening path as project edit. Quote amounts are never treated as revenue.
inventoryHint: Inventory import creates quantity items. Opening quantity is a qty receive to the default location when one exists — not Actual, not expense, not FIFO.
boqItemsHint: BOQ import writes into a draft Bill of Quantities for the project. Blank and total rows are skipped. Duplicate item codes are errors.

mapping.title: Column mapping
mapping.hint: Adjust which CSV column feeds each field, then validate.

preview.title: Preview & validation
preview.summary: {valid} ready · {errors} with errors · {warnings} with warnings · {selected} selected
preview.skipHint: Uncheck rows to skip them. Rows with errors are never imported.

errors.needFile: Choose a CSV or Excel file.
errors.emptySheet: The spreadsheet has no usable rows.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too large to import (max about 2 MB).
errors.nothingSelected: Select at least one valid row to import.
errors.needProjectId: Enter a project ID for BOQ import.
